name: Particle size, two groups: differential + cumulative with d-value tables (2 × 2)
use_case: One row per group of materials (one file per group): differential and cumulative curves, the legend above the row, d10 / d50 / d90 in a table in the cumulative panel.
origin_hint: Origin: four line graphs, X log10, merged 2 × 2 (Graph > Merge Graph Windows); table via Insert > Table.
calculations: cumulative = running sum of the volume % per size class, scaled to 100
d10 / d50 / d90 by interpolation of the cumulative curve
label_policy: labels/peak names only from user files or user confirmation
